next.reason: 1985: "ALTERNATE RECORD KEY IS data-name-1 [ WITH DUPLICATES ]"; 2023: "record-key-name-1 SOURCE IS { data-name-2 } … [ WITH DUPLICATES ] [ SUPPRESS WHEN literal-1 ]". The 1985 form remains valid. 2023 adds a SOURCE-defined key alternative and an optional SUPPRESS WHEN phrase, so it accepts programs the 1985 format refuses.
